common_row_weight_sensitivity.qualification: all four arms give each block equal weight; this is fully target/stream paired but is not in the primary inferential family

primary_calibration_pairing.qualification: shared target and walk streams are common random numbers for every arm, but unequal calibration weights prevent exact target pairing except B-P

descriptive_heterogeneity.scope: descriptive only; no confidence interval or decision label

modeled_population_inference.conditional_on: discovery keyed-modeled-PRP exchangeability, valid no-backfill first-32 selection, and pair-cluster asymptotics with 32 PSUs

family.rademacher_algorithm: mix64(seed xor mix64(draw) xor mix64(domain) xor mix64(cluster)); low bit

modeled_population_inference.method: delete-one-pair jackknife plus per-draw re-studentized Rademacher max-|T| multiplier
modeled_population_inference.one_child_per_parent_limitation: within-parent child-orbit heterogeneity is not separately identified

selected_32_estimand.interpretation: fixed realized selected endpoint set and executed target/walk distribution; no pair-jackknife CI is claimed for this fixed set

setup_and_process_costs.qualification: setup and worker wall seconds are separate descriptive costs; they are not converted to walk_ops or an end-to-end bound

setup_robustness.claim_limit: the fresh-root family is conditional n=16 model-based inference under the frozen SHA-derived-root exchangeability and sign-symmetry model for this fixed 32-slot/97-model panel and fresh target/walk streams; the descriptive bridge has no inferential status; this follow-up estimand differs from the calibrated primary population estimand, so non-persistence cannot by itself identify an original-root accident; neither result establishes conductor causality, security weakness, transfer, or end-to-end advantage

decision.rule: passing A/A and estimable primary family; any of the nine simultaneous 95% CIs strictly excludes zero and abs(estimate)>=trigger_abs_bits
